# Code Style & Formatting

## Formatting

- Line length: 100 chars max
- Indent: 2 spaces, no tabs
- Quotes: single
- Semicolons: required
- Trailing commas: all
- Arrow function parentheses: avoid when possible
- JSX: self-closing tags required, no unnecessary curly braces
